abstract: Manages medical triage zone compliance, clinical equipment readiness, and auxiliary annex intake capacities
system_message:
You are Public Health Coordinator (PHC). As the Public Health Coordinator (PHC), you oversee clinical facility evaluations for emergency management, focusing on two key operational portfolios: evaluating medical triage zone compliance and auxiliary annex intake capacities, and coordinating mass vaccination deployment capabilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Mass vaccination deployment（VACC）
information_points.content:
PHC-VACC-4VA：For Biscayne Ridge Regional High School Complex, pharmacy cold-chain inventory reports a refrigerated medicine storage capacity of 320 L based on total certified 2 to 8 degrees Celsius medical payload storage volume in on-site temperature-controlled medical refrigerator units.
PHC-VACC-TD6：For Pelican Point Multipurpose Arena, the pharmacy cold-chain inventory confirms a total certified 2 to 8 degrees Celsius medical payload storage volume across on-site temperature-controlled medical refrigerator units, providing a refrigerated medicine storage capacity of 180 L.
PHC-VACC-94O：For Harbor Bluffs Civic Exhibition Pavilion, evaluation of on-site temperature-controlled medical refrigerator units verifies a certified 2 to 8 degrees Celsius medical payload storage volume, resulting in a refrigerated medicine storage capacity of 450 L.

information_points.title: Manages medical triage zone compliance, clinical equipment readiness, and auxiliary annex intake capacities（TRIAGE）
information_points.content:
PHC-TRIAGE-ETW：For the Harbor Bluffs Civic Exhibition Pavilion under Layout Configuration v2.0, medical triage zone clearance is approved for the designated special-care and triage wing, and the auxiliary annex intake capacity is certified at 300 person across the secondary reinforced educational wing and multipurpose rooms.
PHC-TRIAGE-5KU：For the Biscayne Ridge Regional High School Complex under Layout Configuration v2.0, medical triage zone clearance is not approved for the designated special-care and triage wing, while the auxiliary annex intake capacity is certified at 300 person across the secondary reinforced educational wing and multipurpose rooms.
PHC-TRIAGE-D1S：For the Pelican Point Multipurpose Arena under Layout Configuration v2.0, medical triage zone clearance is approved for the designated special-care and triage wing, and the certified overflow cot auxiliary annex intake capacity is 200 person across the secondary reinforced educational wing and multipurpose rooms.
PHC-TRIAGE-IXG：For the Pelican Point Multipurpose Arena under Layout Configuration v3.0, medical triage zone clearance is not approved for the designated special-care and triage wing, and the auxiliary annex intake capacity is certified at 400 person across the secondary reinforced educational wing and multipurpose rooms.
